CustomField.description: Checked when the external system may already have acted on the request this issue records: a request that is not safe to repeat (a POST or PATCH sent with no Idempotency-Key) got no response, or got a 500, 502 or 504 response; or the external system accepted the request before the call failed in your org. Pressing Retry sends the request again.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The external system may already have processed this request. Retry sends it again; check the external system first.
CustomField.label: External System May Have Acted
